findings.title: Anchor matching also exempts arbitrary tags beginning with “a”
findings.body: This pattern has no tag-name boundary, so it matches tags such as `<applet>` and `<article>` as though they were anchors. When the same tag appears in the English value, `santizeAnchors` removes it before policy validation; consequently, even active or otherwise disallowed markup can pass verification unchanged. Restrict the pattern to the actual `a` tag (with a tag-name boundary) so non-anchor elements reach the sanitizer.

findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instruction is replaced with Italian
findings.body: This Lithuanian resource now says “Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:”, which is Italian rather than Lithuanian. Lithuanian account users will see an unrelated-language instruction during authenticator setup; replace it with the intended Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login instruction is replaced with Italian
findings.body: This Lithuanian resource now says “Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:”, which is Italian rather than Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an unrelated-language instruction during login authenticator setup; replace it with the intended Lithuanian translation.
